import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Extract hour from time column
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)

# Aggregate total sales by hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum().reset_index()
hourly_sales = hourly_sales.sort_values('hour')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=hourly_sales, x='hour', y='total', marker='o', color='teal')
plt.title('Total Coffee Shop Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Hour (24-hour format)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Extract hour from time column
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)

# Aggregate total sales by hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum().reset_index()
hourly_sales = hourly_sales.sort_values('hour')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=hourly_sales, x='hour', y='total', marker='o', color='teal')
plt.title('Total Coffee Shop Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Hour (24-hour format)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
